name: debug-lib-env-filter
note: Originally a FALSE POSITIVE from the 2026-07-19 MCP scan (contributed to @launchdarkly/mcp-server@0.6.2). The ubiquitous `debug` npm library selects DEBUG_*/`^debug_` env vars (Object.keys(process.env).filter) to configure logging; paired with a normal outbound API call (a Speakeasy-generated SDK hitting its own documented endpoint with a user token), pkgxray read this as bulk-env-harvest + exfil. It is not: no secret is placed in the request. FIXED: the bulk-env matcher now treats `Object.keys(process.env).filter(<key predicate>)` as a prefix-scoped SELECTIVE read, not a whole-env harvest (negative lookahead requiring the filter predicate to test the key), so hasBulkEnv is false and the env+network HIGH no longer fires. A real harvest (JSON.stringify(process.env), or a `.filter(()=>true)` that then sends every value) still matches and BLOCKs. The fetch remains surfaced at INFO (network-access).
